groups.activity: buy the complete set or individual parts
conditions: Volt Prime is vaulted: his relics are absent from normal mission drop tables.
The parts and relics remain tradeable. Buying the set is normally faster than dedicated Aya farming while his Prime Resurgence rotation is inactive.
bonuses: Selling current prime parts for Platinum can fund the set faster than waiting on an unannounced rotation.
Buying relics is a middle path, but leaves the fissure RNG to you.

disclosures.title: price is a snapshot
disclosures.body: The 45-70 Platinum range came from recent community reports, not a live market check. Confirm the price before trading.

groups.meta: bank Aya for a future rotation
conditions: Aya cannot buy Volt relics until Volt returns to Varzia's active Prime Resurgence stock.
Deimos Tier 5 has a 43.48% Aya chance at the final stage; complete bonus objectives because the final stage rolls twice.
Resource and Drop Chance Boosters, Blessings, and Retriever mods do not improve Aya rewards.
bonuses: Use the fast brute-force Tier 5 bounty when it is available.
Aya is best earned alongside standing or other bounty goals; Fortuna bounties and dedicated Void Aya runs are weaker routes.

disclosures.title: Aya is not a Volt voucher
disclosures.body: Prime Resurgence relics are sold only by Varzia during the item's rotation; they do not return to normal mission drop tables. Aya can be stockpiled, but cannot be spent on Volt today if he is off rotation.

groups.meta: only during a Volt Prime rotation
conditions: Confirm Varzia's current relic IDs before buying. This was the Volt offering in the last Loki/Volt rotation.
Varzia's stock rotates every 28 days at 18:00 UTC, but Digital Extremes publishes no fixed cycle.
Buy enough relics before the rotation closes; purchased relics are tradeable and stay openable forever.
bonuses: The Orbiter Relic Segment and Prime Resurgence Market tab access the same Varzia stock.
A Volt bought directly with 3 Regal Aya arrives built with a slot and Orokin Reactor, but is only available during his rotation.

groups.activity: buy his two Volt relics if stocked
conditions: Baro is a real alternative while Volt is vaulted, but he is not guaranteed to bring either relic on a visit.
The displayed 16-relic budget covers a conservative radshare plan; stop buying once you have the needed parts.
Baro visits for 48 hours every two weeks. Check his live inventory rather than planning around an assumed visit.
bonuses: Neo O1 and Axi V8 are tradeable, so a seller can supply them even when Baro does not.
The Axi V8 route puts the difficult Neuroptics and Chassis in one relic era.

disclosures.title: Baro does not unvault Volt
disclosures.body: He is an intermittent exception to Volt's vault status. His relics do not make Volt available from mission drop tables or from off-rotation Varzia stock.

conditions: Refine Uncommon and Rare target relics to Radiant. A four-player Radiant share gives a 34.39% chance of at least one Rare reward.
Run Common target relics Intact: refinement lowers a Common reward from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Collect 10 Reactant before extraction. Every squadmate may choose the same reward, so take another player's Volt part when it appears.
bonuses: Use Radshare.xyz or the Vaulted Relic Community Discord for old-relic groups; recruiting chat can be slow for vaulted relics.
For a 1-Aya relic, radshare saves time; a stagger uses fewer traces but takes roughly four times as long.

disclosures.title: do not public a Radiant rare relic
disclosures.body: A public Neo V8 or Axi V8 run risks 100 Void Traces for only a 10% solo Rare roll. Confirm the exact relic and Radiant refinement with all four players before launching.

conditions: Components can build in parallel. Keep a free Warframe slot available for the final claim.
